dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High boundary sharpness; prominent white fringes on the edges of grey-bodied primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct transition boundary defined by a shift from fine, high-frequency transverse barring on the crown and nape to larger, crescentic scales on the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Pervasive achromatic contrast between dark feather centers and wide white margins across all visible dorsal plumage, creating a high-contrast scalloped effect.
